The 2024 disclosure (nvda_2024_7_D072) details repurchases from Jan 29, 2024 through Feb 16, 2024 (2.8M shares, $1.9B), while the 2025 disclosure (nvda_2025_7_D072) details repurchases from Jan 27, 2025 through Feb 21, 2025 (29M shares, $3.7B). Both cite the Rule 10b5-1/pre-established plan context and the dilution offset purpose.

comparisons.peer_topic: Shareholder Returns and Stock Repurchase Program
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD returned $862 million to shareholders in 2024 through stock repurchases, with $4.7 billion remaining available under a program that has no termination date and may be suspended or discontinued at any time.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose active share repurchase programs in fiscal 2024 with no expiration dates. However, the scale of activity differs significantly: NVDA repurchased $9.7 billion in shares, whereas AMD repurchased a much smaller $862 million. Both companies disclose the remaining authorized amounts at year-end: NVDA had $22.5 billion remaining, while AMD had $4.7 billion remaining.

sentences.text: During fiscal year 2024, we repurchased 21 million shares of our common stock for $9.7 billion.
Our share repurchase program aims to offset dilution from shares issued to employees.
During the twelve months ended December 28, 2024, we returned a total of $862 million to shareholders through the repurchase of 5.9 million shares of common stock under our stock repurchase program.
As of December 28, 2024, $4.7 billion remained available for future stock repurchases under this program.

comparisons.peer_topic: Stock Repurchase Program Utilization and Fiscal Year Activity
comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom utilized all $20 billion of authorized stock repurchase amounts prior to expiration on December 31, 2023, having repurchased approximately 67 million shares for $7,176 million in fiscal year 2024 and 91 million shares for $5,824 million in fiscal year 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies discuss stock repurchase program activity in fiscal 2024. NVDA reports repurchasing 21 million shares for $9.7 billion under a program with no expiration. In contrast, Broadcom utilized its authorized amounts prior to the December 31, 2023 expiration date, repurchasing 67 million shares for $7,176 million in fiscal 2024 and having utilized the full $20 billion authorization.

sentences.text: During fiscal year 2024, we repurchased 21 million shares of our common stock for $9.7 billion.
During fiscal years 2024 and 2023, we repurchased and retired approximately 67 million and 91 million shares of our common stock for $7,176 million and $5,824 million, respectively.

peer_results.rationale: The retrieved candidates focus on debt issuance, credit facility updates, and cessation of capital returns (dividends/repurchases) due to credit rating downgrades and CHIPS Act restrictions. There is no substantive comparable disclosure of an active fiscal 2024 share repurchase program or authorization comparable to NVDA's $9.7 billion buyback activity.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Board authorized discretionary repurchases of up to $10 billion in common stock with no expiration date, through which $7.19 billion had been repurchased as of August 29, 2024, subject to market conditions and cash usage determinations.

NVDA's program aims to offset dilution and had $22.5 billion remaining as of Jan 28, 2024. Micron's board authorized up to $10 billion with no expiration, of which $7.19 billion had been repurchased as of August 29, 2024.

sentences.text: In August 2023, our Board of Directors approved an increase to our share repurchase program of an additional $25.0 billion, without expiration.
Our share repurchase program aims to offset dilution from shares issued to employees.

Our Board of Directors has authorized the discretionary repurchase of up to $10 billion of our outstanding common stock through open-market purchases, block trades, privately-negotiated transactions, derivative transactions, and/or pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 trading plans.

The repurchase authorization has no expiration date, does not obligate us to acquire any common stock, and is subject to market conditions and our ongoing determination of the best use of available cash.

Qualcomm announced a new $15.0 billion authorization in November 2024 in addition to an existing program, also with no expiration, noting that repurchases may be suspended or discontinued at any time.

sentences.text: In August 2023, our Board of Directors approved an increase to our share repurchase program of an additional $25.0 billion, without expiration.
On November 6, 2024, we announced a new $15.0 billion stock repurchase authorization, which is in addition to the aforementioned program.
Repurchases may be made in the open market, through 10b5-1 programs, through accelerated share repurchase programs, in privately negotiated transactions or through the use of derivative instruments.
